exposure: Behavioral science-informed intervention designed to facilitate postpartum-to-primary care transitions (including default PCP visit scheduling, nudge reminders, and tailored language)
outcome: Primary care visits within 1 year postpartum
Annual examination or health care maintenance visit with a PCP within 1 year postpartum
Receipt of screenings or services by a PCP (e.g., weight, blood pressure, mood screening)
cohort: The study included 353 participants with chronic conditions or pregnancy conditions with long-term health risks.
finding: The behavioral science-informed intervention significantly increased the rate of attending an annual examination with a PCP, having a PCP visit for any reason, and mental health disorder screening within 1 year postpartum compared to routine care.
